 Largest Font 
 OL Lyonnes have an opportunity to secure direct qualification for the UEFA Women's Champions League quarterfinals when they face Arsenal in England on Thursday. A victory would guarantee the French side a place among the competition's top four teams, allowing Jonatan Giráldez's squad to bypass the additional knockout round.
 According to the standings reported by Olympique-et-Lyonnais.com, OL Lyonnes lead the league phase with 10 points after four matches. Their record consists of three wins and one draw, leaving the French side in control of its qualification prospects.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 The scheduled match against Arsenal kicks off at 9 p.m. A win would take OL Lyonnes to 13 points, a total Arsenal could no longer reach because the London club currently have eight points and only one additional league-phase fixture remaining.

 Chelsea Beat PSG 1-0 With Late Buurman Goal 
 Arsenal would therefore be eliminated from contention for a top-four finish if OL Lyonnes claim all three points. Bayern Munich, FC Barcelona and Chelsea would remain the only teams capable of finishing ahead of the French club.
 The qualification calculation also accounts for the possibility of those three rivals winning their remaining three matches while OL Lyonnes lose their final league-phase fixture. Even under that scenario, only three competing teams could finish above the French side.
 As a result, victory in England would mathematically guarantee OL Lyonnes a position in the top four, regardless of the remaining results involving their direct competitors.
 Also Read 
 Chelsea Face PSG in Champions League Showdown 
 The top four teams in the league-phase standings advance directly to the Champions League quarterfinals. Securing that position would allow OL Lyonnes to avoid an additional knockout round and move straight into the competition's last eight.
